init.darwin: sh -c 'set -eu; case "${UNC_ENV:-prod}" in prod) base="https://file1-cn.ugnas.com/nas-cli" ;; dev|test) base="https://file-cn-test.ugnas.com/nas-cli" ;; *) echo "Invalid UNC_ENV; expected prod, dev or test" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; if [ -z "${UNC_ENV:-}" ]; then base="${UNC_UPGRADE_URL:-$base}"; fi; tmp="$(mktemp)"; trap '"'"'rm -f "$tmp"'"'"' EXIT; insecure=; if [ "${UNC_INSECURE:-0}" = "1" ]; then insecure=-k; fi; curl -fsSL $insecure -o "$tmp" "$base/install.sh"; UNC_UPDATE_SHELL_RC=1 sh "$tmp"'
init.linux: sh -c 'set -eu; case "${UNC_ENV:-prod}" in prod) base="https://file1-cn.ugnas.com/nas-cli" ;; dev|test) base="https://file-cn-test.ugnas.com/nas-cli" ;; *) echo "Invalid UNC_ENV; expected prod, dev or test" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; if [ -z "${UNC_ENV:-}" ]; then base="${UNC_UPGRADE_URL:-$base}"; fi; tmp="$(mktemp)"; trap '"'"'rm -f "$tmp"'"'"' EXIT; insecure=; if [ "${UNC_INSECURE:-0}" = "1" ]; then insecure=-k; fi; curl -fsSL $insecure -o "$tmp" "$base/install.sh"; UNC_UPDATE_SHELL_RC=1 sh "$tmp"'
init.win32: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $releaseEnv=if($env:UNC_ENV){$env:UNC_ENV}else{'prod'}; if(@('prod','dev','test') -cnotcontains $releaseEnv){throw 'Invalid UNC_ENV; expected prod, dev or test'}; $defaultBase=if($releaseEnv -cin @('dev','test')){'https://file-cn-test.ugnas.com/nas-cli'}else{'https://file1-cn.ugnas.com/nas-cli'}; $base=if(!$env:UNC_ENV -and $env:UNC_UPGRADE_URL){$env:UNC_UPGRADE_URL.TrimEnd('/')}else{$defaultBase}; $uri=$base+'/install.ps1'; $f=Join-Path $env:TEMP ('unc-install-'+[guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')+'.ps1'); Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $uri -OutFile $f; & $f"
